0022600026.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-6, on a five-game losing streak and 10th in the East) host the Boston Celtics (6-2, on a one-game winning streak and 3rd in the East) in the Hornets' 10th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. Hornets Grant Williams (out, hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (day-to-day, game-time decision, leg soreness) are unavailable, while Celtics Devin Carter (out, illness) and Payton Pritchard (day-to-day, game-time decision, eye abrasion) are also listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Hornets lost the season series 1-2, including a 113-102 loss in Boston on April 7, 2026.
